cut: The Brink 2, VIRAL CUT v1 (23 Oct) of Break Glass in Emergency. Owner, 23 Oct, after the viral Doodle 5: 'Test other 2 as well and rest after'; this is one of the rest. The format is plan/films/23b-ends-in-3-viral.md. The hook is frame 0, and the last frame hands back to it.
argument: Finland's temporary border law of 2024 has never been used. It was extended to 2026, and now 2028 is proposed, unchanged; a committee agreed. Never used, still temporary.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.ja: フィンランドの 国境法、 / [一度も 使われず]。

captions.source: The Act on Temporary Measures to Combat Instrumentalised Migration (2024) has never been applied: the Finnish Government's and the Interior Ministry's situation pages (applying it needs a separate decision); Helsinki Times and others on the 2026 proposal (plan/films/19-break-glass.md). 'Border law' describes it; the nickname is never used on screen.
In force from 22 Jul 2024 for one year (EUAA; Finnish Government; Edilex on HE 148/2026), as v1.

text.ja: 2026年まで 延長。 / 今度の 提案は / [2028年]。

captions.source: Extended to 31 Dec 2026 by Parliament on 4 Jun 2025, 168–29 (Eduskunta press release; EUAA). Government proposal of 3 Sep 2026 (HE 148/2026, number single-source): validity to 31 Dec 2028 (Finnish Government; Edilex). No plenary vote found on 23 Oct, so 'proposed' stands.

text.ja: 内容は そのまま。 / 委員会は [了承]。

captions.source: The 2026 proposal makes no changes to the content (Finnish Government; Edilex). Constitutional Law Committee statement, 16 Oct 2026: it can be enacted as an exception to the Constitution and is necessary; two members dissented (Yle, Kaleva/Uutissuomalainen, Demokraatti, Verkkouutiset), as v1.

text.ja: 使われず、 / なお [一時的]。 / 提案は 2028年まで。

captions.source: The station's line, over its own image: the case, glass whole, NEVER USED stamped on it, its tag rewritten 2025, 2026, 2028. 'Proposed' stays until the plenary vote passes; then the third line becomes 'Now until 2028.' (fi 'Nyt 2028 loppuun.', ja '今は 2028年まで。'). Re-check on the morning of posting.

plate.why: the case's plate, as v1: the idiom is the joke, in English in every master; the caption carries the point

post.en: Finland's temporary border law has never been used. Passed in 2024 for one year, extended to 2026, now proposed until 2028, unchanged. A parliamentary committee agreed; the plenary vote is still to come. When does temporary end? #Finland
post.fi: Suomen väliaikaista rajalakia ei ole kertaakaan käytetty. Säädettiin 2024 vuodeksi, jatkettiin 2026 loppuun, nyt esitetään vuoden 2028 loppuun sisältö ennallaan. Perustuslakivaliokunta puolsi; täysistunnon äänestys on vielä edessä. Milloin väliaikainen loppuu?
post.ja: フィンランドの一時的な国境法は、一度も使われていない。2024年に期限1年で制定、2026年末まで延長、今度は内容そのままで2028年末までの延長が提案され、議会の委員会が了承した。本会議の採決はこれから。一時的は、いつ終わる？
